title: Smart Data Models - Gaia-X Ontology - Datacenter
description: https://w3id.org/gaia-x/2.1.11#class/Datacenter. A datacenter is an aggregation of availability zones. Subclass of PhysicalResource per the Gaia-X ontology; inherited properties are documented on the PhysicalResource model and not repeated here.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'Datacenter'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

aggregationOfResources.description: Relationship. References the availability zones (at least one must exist) out of which a datacenter is aggregated. Links to one or more AvailabilityZone entities.
